techQuotes.text: As a result, when designing our interface it was necessary to identify a fundamental set of interactions that were both appropriate to the task and also compatible with the available sensor technology.
Technical Overview The bottles interface incorporates wireless sensing technology designed by Joe Paradiso at the MIT Media Lab [3].
Sensing the manipulation of the bottles is made possible through the use of small electromagnetic resonator tags placed around the opening of each bottle, and pieces of ferrite embedded in the corks.
Although the sound was obviously generated by the speakers, many people raised the bottles to their ears to see if the sound was literally coming from the bottle.
